2608.21265.title: Memory Augmentation Unlocks Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
2608.21265.paper_summary: Large language models often rely on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex tasks, but verbose reasoning traces introduce substantial inference overhead. CoT compression shortens generation, yet aggressive compression may disrupt logical coherence and degrade performance. We formalize this trade-off as the \textit{Context-Generation Substitution Law}, where explicit reasoning context substitutes for part of decode-time generation. Based on this principle, we propose \textit{Memory-Augmented Compression}, a training-free framework that constructs reusable reasoning memories from historical traces and retrieves them as prefill-side scaffolds. Rather than using raw demonstrations, these memories summarize reusable reasoning patterns, key constraints, and critical operations to compensate for information lost during compression. Experiments show that Memory consistently improves prompt-based Chain-of-Draft (CoD) compression across mathematical reasoning, complex reasoning, and science question answering tasks, yielding accuracy gains of 21.4, 28.0, 29.5, and 6.61 points over CoD on GSM8K, MATH, BBH, and MMLU-Sci, while achieving a 1.14--1.49$\times$ latency speedup over standard CoT. Memory is also compatible with token-level, reasoning-trace-level, and inference-state compression mechanisms. Further analyzes show that the gains come from relevant reasoning memories rather than simply increasing context length.
2608.21265.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型通常依賴於思維鏈（CoT）推理來解決複雜任務，但冗長的推理痕跡會引入相當大的推理開銷。CoT 壓縮縮短了生成時間，但過度壓縮可能會破壞邏輯一致性並降低性能。我們將這一權衡形式化為 \textit{上下文-生成替代法則}，在此法則中，明確的推理上下文替代了部分解碼時間的生成。基於這一原則，我們提出 \textit{記憶增強壓縮}，這是一個無需訓練的框架，從歷史痕跡中構建可重用的推理記憶，並將其作為預填側支架進行檢索。這些記憶總結了可重用的推理模式、關鍵約束和關鍵操作，以補償在壓縮過程中損失的信息，而不是使用原始示範。實驗表明，記憶在數學推理、複雜推理和科學問題回答任務中，持續改善基於提示的草稿鏈（CoD）壓縮，並在 GSM8K、MATH、BBH 和 MMLU-Sci 上分別獲得 21.4、28.0、29.5 和 6.61 的準確度提升，同時在標準 CoT 上實現 1.14--1.49$\times$ 的延遲加速。記憶也與標記級、推理痕跡級和推理狀態壓縮機制兼容。進一步的分析顯示，這些增益來自相關的推理記憶，而不僅僅是增加上下文長度。
